I am a young woman here in SNNP, and this small wheat plot is important for my family's food. I can afford a little DAP and urea from the cooperative, but not as much as the extension worker recommends — I will put what I can and add manure from our animals to stretch it. I will use improved seed if the cooperative has it this season because the yield is better, but I cannot afford pesticide and we have no irrigation here, so I depend on the rains. My husband and I will do most of the work ourselves, and I will call on a few neighbors for weeding and harvest time.
